page.layout: One printed page, single column of verse and text, centred headings; catchword "Qui" at lower right; signature "D 3" at foot centre-right; faint show-through from the reverse page in the background (not transcribed).

main_text.head: FVNEBRIA.
main_text.l: Ad tempus, nobis: Domino tua vita superstes,
Insertus vita viti qui palmes adhæret,
Non metuit falcem, mors violenta, tuam.
main_text.head: ALIVD.
VVidebramus amicis loquitur.
main_text.l: Quam mihi terra dedit patriam male fida, repulsum
In cœlis pia quæ mansit me patria, tristi
O nati, ô coniunx, meus, ô vos, sanguis, amici
Vt mundo nasci mors est: sic prorsus, eidem,
main_text.head: CYGNVS CANTANS.
EPIGRAMMA
IN OBITVM FRIDERICI VVIDEBRAMI THEOL. D. scriptum ab EBERHARDO DEDEKINO BREMENSI.
main_text.p: FAma fidem fecit moriturus vt ardua Cygnus Aptet in argutos ora, trahatq;, modos: Scilicet à Zephyris vbi forte remurmuret aër, Spiritum𝍐 alto in gutture formạt opus.

page.notes: Printed "Est" in the first poem is set with the ligature-like long s and ampersand as shown; the Greek-style ligature in "Spirituum" and the letter forms in "formạt" are doubtful. The first initial "F" of the epigram is a large woodcut-style initial, joined to "Ama". Ornamental pen-like marks appear in the margins but are not printed text. The faint text in the background belongs to the reverse page and is not transcribed.
